summary: OpenCode application makes external API calls to 6 major service categories: models metadata (models.dev), code/web search (Exa MCP), analytics (Honeycomb), session sharing (api.opencode.ai), GitHub integration (api.github.com), and authentication (GitHub OAuth). All external egress is controlled via OPENCODE_BLOCK_EXTERNAL_APIS and OPENCODE_ONLY_GITHUB flags with a strict allowlist.

external_apis.name: models.dev
external_apis.purpose: Fetch AI model metadata and pricing information (all available providers, models, capabilities, costs)
external_apis.gdpr_concern: Retrieves public model metadata; no user data transmitted. Can be disabled with OPENCODE_ONLY_GITHUB or OPENCODE_DISABLE_MODELS_FETCH flag.

external_apis.name: Exa AI - Web Search (MCP)
external_apis.purpose: Provides websearch tool capability via Model Context Protocol (MCP). Searches the web and returns relevant content.
external_apis.gdpr_concern: Transmits user search queries to Exa AI. Subject to user permission via ctx.ask(). Blocked in GitHub-only mode. Audit logged when used.

external_apis.name: Exa AI - Code Search (MCP)
external_apis.purpose: Provides codesearch tool to find relevant code context, APIs, libraries, and SDK examples via Model Context Protocol.
external_apis.gdpr_concern: Transmits search queries to Exa AI. Subject to user permission. Blocked in GitHub-only mode. Audit logged.

external_apis.name: Honeycomb Analytics
external_apis.purpose: Sends metrics and analytics for AI model completions (chat, messages, responses) to Honeycomb for monitoring and observability.
external_apis.gdpr_concern: HIGH - Transmits request metadata including: Cloudflare geolocation (continent, country, city, region, latitude, longitude, timezone), request length, response status, IP address, response duration. No direct user PII but location data is precise. Token: HONEYCOMB_API_KEY (from Resource.HONEYCOMB_API_KEY.value)

external_apis.name: api.opencode.ai (Share Sync)
external_apis.purpose: Synchronizes session data (messages, state, metadata) to Opencode cloud service for session sharing and persistence.
external_apis.gdpr_concern: HIGH - Transmits full session data (messages, context, code, reasoning) to remote server. Requires explicit sharing decision from user. Can be disabled with OPENCODE_DISABLE_SHARE=true.

external_apis.name: GitHub API
external_apis.purpose: Multiple functions: OAuth authentication, fetching user emails, user profile data, GitHub Actions integration, PR/issue queries.
external_apis.gdpr_concern: CRITICAL - Requests OAuth scope 'read:user', 'user:email', 'repo'. Transmits user email, profile data, and GitHub tokens. Used for authentication and GitHub Actions integration.

external_apis.name: Google OAuth (Authentication)
external_apis.purpose: OAuth provider for user authentication in console application.
external_apis.gdpr_concern: CRITICAL - Google OAuth authentication. Transmits user email and profile data. Token: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID (from Resource.GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.value)

external_apis.name: GitHub App Token Exchange
external_apis.purpose: Exchange GitHub App token or OIDC token for OpenCode service token in GitHub Actions context.
external_apis.gdpr_concern: Transmits GitHub OIDC token or access token to Opencode service for authentication in CI/CD pipelines.

external_apis.name: GitHub App Installation Query
external_apis.purpose: Query Opencode API to get GitHub App installation details for a specific repository.
external_apis.gdpr_concern: Queries installation details; may reveal repository ownership and installation status.

external_apis.name: Custom Instructions Fetch
external_apis.purpose: Dynamically fetch instruction files from URLs specified in opencode.json configuration.
external_apis.gdpr_concern: User-controlled. Fetches arbitrary URLs specified in config. Can expose user config URLs in error logs.

external_apis.name: Stripe Webhook Handler
external_apis.purpose: Receive and process Stripe payment webhooks for subscription management.
endpoints: Inbound only: receives POST from Stripe webhooks
external_apis.gdpr_concern: Receives payment and subscription data from Stripe. May include customer email and billing information.

websocket_connections: No direct WebSocket usage detected. MCP (Model Context Protocol) uses JSON-RPC over HTTP POST.

egress_policy.implementation: Strict allowlist-based egress control via OPENCODE_BLOCK_EXTERNAL_APIS and OPENCODE_ONLY_GITHUB environment variables
blocklist: All domains NOT in allowlist when OPENCODE_BLOCK_EXTERNAL_APIS=1 or OPENCODE_ONLY_GITHUB=1
egress_policy.enforcement: fetchWithPolicy() wrapper enforces allowlist. hostAllowed() validates URLs. Blocked package installs prevented via packageAllowed(). Audit trail recorded for all violations.
control_functions: isEgressBlocked() - returns true if OPENCODE_BLOCK_EXTERNAL_APIS or OPENCODE_ONLY_GITHUB set
hostAllowed(url) - validates URL hostname against ALLOWED_DOMAINS
fetchWithPolicy(input, init) - enforces policy on fetch() calls
fetchWithToolBypass(input, init) - allows specific tools (webfetch, websearch, codesearch) to bypass egress block with permission check
packageAllowed(pkg) - validates package names against ALLOWED_PACKAGES
special_cases: Tools (webfetch, websearch, codesearch) can bypass egress block after permission check via fetchWithToolBypass()
Only @ai-sdk/github-copilot provider is allowed to install when egress is blocked
GitHub-only mode (OPENCODE_ONLY_GITHUB) returns minimal github-copilot manifest without network fetch

recommendations.issue: Honeycomb analytics sends precise geolocation data (country, city, coordinates, timezone)
recommendations.action: Implement: 1) User consent for analytics, 2) Geohash instead of precise coordinates, 3) Ability to disable HONEYCOMB_API_KEY via config, 4) Documentation of what data is transmitted
recommendations.gdpr_implication: Precise location data may require explicit GDPR consent in EU

recommendations.issue: Session sharing transmits full conversation context including code and reasoning to remote API
recommendations.action: Implement: 1) Encrypted transmission to api.opencode.ai, 2) Clear user warning about data transmission, 3) Option to encrypt shares client-side, 4) Data retention policy disclosure
recommendations.gdpr_implication: User data transit across network without explicit user action requires privacy policy

recommendations.issue: Custom instruction URLs can be arbitrary, potentially exposing internal network URLs in errors
recommendations.action: Implement: 1) URL scheme validation, 2) Error sanitization to not expose full URLs in logs, 3) Whitelist of allowed domains for instructions, 4) Timeout enforcement

recommendations.issue: GitHub OAuth requests scopes that grant access to private repositories (implied by repo scope)
recommendations.action: Implement: 1) Document minimum required scopes, 2) Request only necessary scopes (read:user, user:email), 3) Add scope warning in UI, 4) Rotate tokens regularly
recommendations.gdpr_implication: Broad OAuth scopes could grant unintended access to user data

recommendations.issue: No explicit audit logging of fetch calls outside of tool bypass
recommendations.action: Implement: 1) Audit trail for all external API calls, 2) Log queries sent to models.dev and Exa AI, 3) Retention policy (e.g., 90 days), 4) User access to audit logs

recommendations.issue: Egress policy relies on environment variables that could be forgotten/misconfigured
recommendations.action: Implement: 1) Default to OPENCODE_BLOCK_EXTERNAL_APIS=true in offline/air-gapped deployments, 2) Log warning on startup listing all external APIs available, 3) Config file validation to warn about egress

recommendations.issue: Exa AI (websearch, codesearch) endpoints are hardcoded and require external API key not visible in code
recommendations.action: Implement: 1) Document where Exa API key is configured, 2) Add health check for Exa endpoints, 3) Graceful fallback when Exa unavailable

recommendations.issue: GitHub Actions GitHub App token exchange is not rate-limited
recommendations.action: Implement: 1) Rate limiting on token exchange endpoint, 2) Logging of token exchanges with user/workflow ID, 3) Token expiration/revocation mechanism
recommendations.security_implication: Potential for token abuse in automated workflows

recommendations.issue: Honeycomb API key and other service credentials stored in Resource objects
recommendations.action: Implement: 1) Audit who has access to Resource values, 2) Rotate credentials regularly, 3) Use short-lived tokens, 4) Document credential rotation process
recommendations.security_implication: Leaked credentials could expose analytics/service access

recommendations.issue: No circuit breaker pattern for external API dependencies (models.dev, Exa AI, Honeycomb)
recommendations.action: Implement: 1) Circuit breakers for all external APIs with fallback behavior, 2) Graceful degradation when services unavailable, 3) Service health dashboard
recommendations.operational_implication: Service outages could impact user experience

notes: OpenCode has well-implemented egress controls via OPENCODE_BLOCK_EXTERNAL_APIS and OPENCODE_ONLY_GITHUB flags suitable for air-gapped/GitHub-only deployments
GitHub-only mode (OPENCODE_ONLY_GITHUB) restricts to GitHub Copilot provider and disables webfetch/websearch/codesearch tools - good for sensitive environments
User data transmission is significant: session sharing sends full conversation context, Honeycomb sends precise geolocation, GitHub OAuth accesses user emails/profile
Audit logging is partially implemented (webfetch/websearch/codesearch have audit trails) but missing for other external calls (models.dev, share sync)
All external API URLs are centralized and configurable via environment variables (OPENCODE_API, OPENCODE_MODELS_URL), enabling self-hosted deployments
Exa AI integration (websearch, codesearch) is tool-based and permission-gated - users must explicitly grant permission to use these features
No telemetry/analytics SDK detected (Honeycomb is server-side only in log processor, not in client)
VCS detection (git-specific) is read-only and doesn't transmit repo data automatically - only when user initiates GitHub Actions workflow
Plugin system exists but no evidence of automatic plugin updates/downloads from external sources - plugins specified in config or local files
Model metadata fetch (models.dev) happens on startup and every 60 minutes, critical for provider availability. Can be cached/disabled with OPENCODE_DISABLE_MODELS_FETCH

execution_log.findings: 22 fetch locations identified across models, auth, sharing, tools, and analytics
models.dev API integration, 60-min refresh interval, models.json cache
Comprehensive egress control with allowlist, blockingFlags, audit trail
Exa AI MCP integration, tool-gated permission model, 25sec timeout
Honeycomb analytics with precise geolocation data (lat/lon/timezone)
Session sharing API calls, configurable endpoint, disable flag available
GitHub API usage for auth, PR/issue queries, token exchange
